newsitem.title: JAPAN: INSIGHT - JGBs seen range-bound in Tokyo.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - JGBs seen range-bound in Tokyo.

text.p: FUTURE RANGE/DAY SPPRT RSTNC RSI-9 MA-5 MA-25
OUTLOOK OF BOJ OPERATION AT 0020 GMT: injection 100 bln yen

*JGBs likely to be stuck in recent trading ranges in absence of fresh factors. *MOF expected to offer new 6-year JGBs with prospective coupon of 1.9 percent. *MOF asked underwriters on Monday to reduce issue volume of the 6-year JGBs to 400 billion from 500 billion. *Market keen for details of developments in Japanese financial scandal.
